Product Features

  • Combining practicality and creativity: The bed has a general roof shape, which expands the space for movement. The front is equipped with an 84*39cm blackboard, making it a cost-effective bed that combines entertainment and sleeping functions. The unique construction allows you to add an imaginative sense of creativity to your child's bedroom.
  • Multiple storage functions: The front and sides of the bed are equipped with drawers with different storage volumes. The size of the large front drawer is 150x67x17 cm, which can be used to store large items such as blankets or children's sleeping dolls. The size of the side drawer is 86 x 45 x 17 cm and can store some drawing chalk.
  • Three-sided fence: To ensure the safety of children while they sleep, the bed has three side rails with rounded corners to prevent injury from touching the sharp edges. The included extendable slatted bases are made of 100% pine wood and can support up to 120 kg. This complies with safety standards and is child-friendly and promotes sustainable development.
  • Sturdy construction made of solid pine: The mini loft bed is made of two extremely stable materials, which are ideal for use in the children's room. It is made of high-quality pine wood and, thanks to the robust material, offers the necessary stability to withstand even the wildest romp of your child. The bottom of the drawer is made of MDF.
  • Detailed Information :To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.
